change_summary: The article was retracted and replaced by a corrected version, after an earlier expression of concern about the calculation of the dose-response analysis. The Table 3 slope was miscalculated: it was reported as 0.45 points per 10 mg and the correct value is 0.28, and the stored paper's 0.45 (CI 0.30 to 0.60) becomes 0.28 (CI 0.15 to 0.41) in the corrected version. The notice says the finding that iron supplementation reduces fatigue is unchanged, so the change is to the size of the dose effect. Because a corrected version exists, the change is of medium severity rather than a loss of all findings.
evaluation: Your Discussion cites Park and Singh [7] to compare your slope of 0.41 with their 0.45 per 10 mg, saying this supports the validity of your design. The notice says the 0.45 was miscalculated and the correct value is 0.28, so this comparison is touched. Overall the impact on your draft is low, since it is a single comparison and the change is of medium severity.
recommendation: Your Discussion compares your slope of 0.41 with the 0.45 per 10 mg of Park and Singh [7], saying this supports the validity of your design. The notice says the slope was reported as 0.45 points per 10 mg but the correct value is 0.28, and the article was retracted and replaced by a corrected version. Update the number in that sentence to the corrected 0.28, cite the corrected version after checking the figure there, and re-check whether the comparison still supports your design.
